prompt: Generate frames for a half-body GIF emoji pack of the character in the image in a cartoon Line style, ensuring the headwear and hairstyle are correct. Use a 4x4 layout to generate a total of 16 small images. These 16 images should depict continuous split actions of a "blowing a kiss" animation, which can be combined into a complete, smooth loop where the last frame cycles back to the first. Each of the 16 images should include the text "I love you" in a font that matches the image. Provide enough white space between the 16 images for easy cutting, ensuring each image stays within its area. Do not copy the original image exactly; only use the character. The background should be pure white without divider lines. Aspect ratio 1:1.
